scope: fixed selected Gaia EDR3 cohort and saved linear estimator; declared correlation-family sensitivity
units: source and coefficient covariance mas^2/year^2; displayed widths microas/year; kernel dimensionless
tangent_convention: ICRS east=mu_alpha*cos(delta), north=mu_delta; principal symmetric covariance square root
covariance_family: Cij=(1-rho)*deltaij*Ci + rho*kij*Si*Ei*Ej^T*Sj; Si=principal sqrt(Ci), Ei=2x3 tangent rows
rho_meaning: fraction of every source marginal covariance assigned to correlated component; sqrt(rho) latent amplitude, not universal pair correlation
half_angle_meaning: angular separation where scalar latent kernel equals one half; tangent/coloring factors change observed cross correlation
grid_status: fixed declared sensitivity grid; not empirical fit
estimator: saved M unchanged; compute M C M^T, no GLS refit
sky_support_status: fixed outcome-selected 4756-row cohort, directions treated exact
null_mock_status: algebraic dense fixtures only; empirical Gaia joint law unavailable
caveats: This is an assumed covariance family; the actual Gaia cross-source law and amplitude are unmeasured.
Keeping each marginal covariance fixed redistributes variance; directional widths can shrink or grow and need not be monotone relative to independence.
The coefficient center uses the original estimator; correlation-sensitive optimal estimation is not evaluated.
Conditioning on the outcome-selected upstream cohort does not remove selection bias.
No empirical p-value, physical Gaia coverage, native solver or Bianchi family identification follows.
gaussian_reference_mean_law: beta_hat - beta_ref ~ N(0,V), beta_ref=M E[y], conditional on fixed design and the declared covariance; physical-coefficient coverage additionally requires zero or separately bounded deterministic bias
